records.title: t1 and z unpacked from 5- and 9-byte groups with bounded-int splits and one range check per coefficient, on top of the ExpandA/NTT/syscall package
w1 packed straight into 64-bit words for the c-tilde syscall (32 coefficients per 3 words) and bounded-int mod-q reductions in the block NTT
Row products in 16-coefficient chunks with bounded-int reductions, bounded-int UseHint split, on top of the w1-word syscall package
c-tilde taken from the first signature felt as four lanes: SampleInBall absorbs one padded block from them and the final check compares the syscall u256 directly
Hint encoding validated in one pass over popped position bytes (no indexed reads), on top of the c-tilde lane package
ExpandA squeezes on the permutation's packed lane-pair state: seed packed once, only the 11 rate words split per block, no repacking
tr = SHAKE-256(pk) absorbed on the packed lane-pair state (key lanes paired straight into the 13-word state), on top of the packed ExpandA
